title: Zero-Trust Cloud Security & $250K+ Enterprise FinOps
tagline: Spearheaded cloud security posture management and financial operations across complex multi-cloud enterprise footprints.
businessImpact: Directly unlocked $250K+ in recurring cloud savings while hardening security compliance across SOC2 and ISO standards with zero breaches.
architecture: Enforced zero-trust identity policies, automated IAM privilege pruning, automated cloud cost telemetry, and commitment utilization governance.
snippet:
// Security & Cost Telemetry Aggregation
SELECT 
    project_id, 
    service_name, 
    security_policy_compliance_status,
    SUM(cost_in_usd) as monthly_burn
FROM cloud_governance.enterprise_telemetry
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 HAVING monthly_burn > 5000;
